name: Heatblast
lore: A magma-based lifeform from the star Pyros capable of controlling intense plasma flames and riding fireballs at high speed.

name: Wildmutt
lore: An eyeless predator from the dark planet Vulpin that perceives its surroundings through gill-slit thermal and chemical sensors.

name: Diamondhead
lore: A silicon-based warrior made of ultra-dense organic taydenite-like crystal capable of morphing limbs into blades and reflecting lasers.

name: XLR8
lore: A raptor-like speedster with wheeled feet and a protective visor capable of exceeding 500 mph and running across water or vertical walls.

name: Grey Matter
lore: A diminutive five-inch amphibian from Galvan Prime whose cerebral capacity outclasses almost any supercomputer in the galaxy.

name: Stinkfly
lore: An insectoid flyer capable of aerial acrobatics and firing pressurized streams of immobilizing orcorrosive slime from four eye-stalks.

name: Ripjaws
lore: An amphibious deep-sea hunter whose unhinging jaws can bite through solid titanium hulls and swim at torpedo velocities.

name: Upgrade
lore: A self-assembling nanotechnology organism composed of billions of liquid-metal nanites that merges with and upgrades any machine.

name: Ghostfreak
lore: A spectral entity from the dimensional void of Anur Phaetos capable of turning invisible, phasing through matter, and possessing foes.

name: Four Arms
lore: A twelve-foot four-armed gladiator from the desert world Khoros whose sheer muscular power creates shockwaves with a single clap.

name: Cannonbolt
lore: A heavily armored hulking alien who curls into an indestructible motorized sphere capable of ricocheting through fortified bunkers.

name: Wildvine
lore: A sentient botanical lifeform capable of stretching thorny vines, burrowing underground, and hurling smoke or concussion seed bombs.

name: Spitter
lore: A pufferfish-like alien from Scalpasc that inflates to launch a massive, high-pressure blast of slippery, conductive bio-slime.

name: Buzzshock
lore: A living mischievous electrical battery capable of traveling through power grids at light speed and splitting into clones when cut.

name: Arctiguana
lore: A reptilian cryokinetic alien capable of exhaling long-range freezing vapor that encases targets in solid glacial ice instantly.

name: Blitzwolfer
lore: A werewolf-like alien from Anur Transyl's moon whose snout splits into four quadrants to unleash a destructive ultrasonic shockwave.

name: Upchuck
lore: A compact Gourmand with four stretchable tongues and a trans-dimensional stomach that converts solid matter or lasers into explosive plasma.

name: Snare-Oh
lore: An ancient mummy-like alien composed entirely of tensile, sentient linen bandages that unravel to dodge attacks or ensnare giant foes.

name: Frankenstrike
lore: A bio-electromagnetic titan equipped with dual shoulder-mounted Tesla coils combining heavy physical brawn with high-voltage engineering.

name: Ditto
lore: Arubber-bodied Splixson capable of multiplying into dozens of independent clones instantly to overwhelm opponents with teamwork.

name: Eye Guy
lore: An Opticoid covered in dozens of mobile eyes across his torso that can fire elemental energy beams or merge into one colossal chest eye.

name: Way Big
lore: Born inside unpredictable cosmic storms, this 120-foot colossus commands unmatched physical power and fires devastating cosmic rays.

name: Swampfire
lore: A swamp-dwelling plant-humanoid from Methanos that combines superhuman strength, vine control, limb regeneration, and methane fireballs.

name: Echo Echo
lore: A living amplified soundwave contained in a silicon containment suit capable of multiplying into an army of sonic clones.

name: Humungousaur
lore: A colossal Vaxasaurian powerhouse from Terradino capable of growing up to 60 feet tall with exponentially increasing strength.

name: Jetray
lore: A manta-ray-like Aerophibian capable of flying faster than the speed of sound and firing neuroshock beams from his eyes and tail.

name: Big Chill
lore: A moth-like phantom alien from Kylmyys who phases through solid matter while freezing targets from the inside out.

name: Chromastone
lore: The guardian of Petropia composed of living ultraviolet conductor crystal that absorbs energy blasts and channels them into prismatic beams.

name: Brainstorm
lore: A hyper-intelligent crustacean whose hinged carapace opens to unleash devastating cerebro-electrical lightning storms.

name: Spidermonkey
lore: A six-limbed simian acrobat from Aranhaschimmia who traps larger foes in steel-strong tail webs and dodges strikes effortlessly.

name: Goop
lore: A 200-pound unicellular slime controlled by an overhead anti-gravity UFO projector capable of dissolving metal or cushioning impacts.

name: Alien X
lore: An omnipotent dimensional entity from the Forge of Creation whose thoughts reshape space, time, and reality itself once Serena and Bellicus agree.

name: Upchuck (Murk)
lore: The dark-green Murk subspecies of Gourmand from Peptos XI capable of devouring giant boulders and spitting curved plasma barrages.

name: Nanomech
lore: A microscopic biomechanical alien smaller than a needle point who infiltrates machinery and unleashes concentrated bio-electric bursts.

name: Lodestar
lore: A living magnetic field with a floating metal head between horned shoulders who crushes or hurls any metallic structure at will.

name: Rath
lore: Let me tell you something! An enraged Appoplexian tiger-brawler with retractable knuckle blades and fearless close-combat dominance.

name: Waterhazard
lore: An armored red-shelled crustacean from Kiusana who fires high-pressure hydro-blasts from his palms and shrugs off heavy artillery.

name: Ampfibian
lore: A jellyfish-like electromagnetic being from Tesslos capable of transforming into pure electricity, reading minds through neural impulses, and flying.

name: Armodrillo
lore: A yellow mechanical-armored Talpaedan with hydraulic piston-drills built into his forearms capable of triggering magnitude-10 earthquakes.

name: Terraspin
lore: An aerodynamic tortoise from Aldabra whose limbs retract to spin like a giant turbine fan, generating hurricane-force wind tunnels.

name: NRG
lore: A living thermonuclear core sealed inside an indestructible lead-alloy furnace suit that vents searing crimson radiation beams.

name: Fasttrack
lore: A feline speedster from Chalybeas who combines high-velocity running with stronger upper-body physical carrying and striking power.

name: Chamalien
lore: A three-eyed lizard alien capable of blending seamlessly into any background environment and striking with a hidden tail spike.

name: Eatle
lore: A rhinoceros-beetle alien who devours solid debris with steel jaws and fires concentrated green energy beams from his cranial horn.

name: Clockwork
lore: A mechanical clockwork titan capable of firing green time-rays that slow time to a standstill, age targets to dust, or restore timelines.

name: Juryrigg
lore: A hyperactive gremlin mechanic who dismantles complex machinery in seconds and reassembles scrap into overpowered laser cannons.

name: Shocksquatch
lore: A muscular electric yeti from Pattersonea who charges static friction in his thick fur to unleash devastating high-voltage punches.

name: Feedback
lore: Ben's favorite Conductoid from the Teslavorr Nebula whose plug-tipped antennae and tail absorb and fire back any form of energy in the universe.

name: Whampire
lore: A vampiric predator from Anur Vladibus capable of firing Corruptura parasites, hypnotizing foes, and unleashing sonic explosions.

name: Gutrot
lore: A walking gastro-chemical laboratory with innate encyclopedic chemistry mastery who synthesizes any compound gas on demand.

name: Atomix
lore: A noble nuclear powerhouse second only to Alien X who generates miniature stars and devastating atomic fusion blasts.

name: Bullfrag
lore: A peak-condition Incursean commando frog with sleek sunglasses, explosive jumping power, and a long prehensile grappling tongue.

name: Astrodactyl
lore: A pterosaur-like alien from Terradino with a organic star-powered jetpack and retractable energy whips on his wrists.

name: Toepick
lore: An ogre-like alien wearing an iron cage helmet; opening the cage reveals a visage so terrifying it paralyzes even cosmic beings.

name: Kickin Hawk
lore: Ben's premier close-quarters martial artist—a hawk-like fighter with razor elbow blades and unmatched kicking speed and precision.

name: The Worst
lore: A small yellow Atrocian with zero offensive power whose rubbery body is completely indestructible against any physical or energy attack.

name: Mole-Stache
lore: A dapper rodent alien whose shapeshifting mustache forms giant boxing fists, grappling ropes, or helicopter blades.

name: Pesky Dust
lore: A tiny fairy-like Nemuina whose shimmering sleep dust puts even the strongest titans to sleep instantly and enters their dreams.

name: Walkatrout
lore: A tiny, leg-walking blue fish whose ultra-slick skin makes him impossible for enemies to grab or hold onto.

name: Ball Weevil
lore: A small golden insectoid who spits sticky plasma orbs and rolls on top of them to collect matter until they detonate like giant bombs.

name: Crashopper
lore: A grasshopper-like alien with pneumatic hind legs capable of leaping miles into the air and slamming into targets like a cannonball.
